# marmot_service_account_api_key (Resource)

An API key on a service account. The plaintext is only returned at creation and is kept in state as the sensitive `key` attribute. Any change replaces the key. An account holds at most 5 keys.

## Create an expiring key

```terraform
resource "marmot_service_account_api_key" "ci" {
  service_account_id = marmot_service_account.etl.id
  name               = "ci"
  expires_in_days    = 90
}
```

## Create a key that never expires

```terraform
resource "marmot_service_account_api_key" "ci" {
  service_account_id = marmot_service_account.etl.id
  name               = "ci"
}
```

## Hand the key to another provider

```terraform
resource "marmot_service_account_api_key" "ci" {
  service_account_id = marmot_service_account.etl.id
  name               = "ci"
  expires_in_days    = 90
}

resource "github_actions_secret" "marmot_api_key" {
  repository      = "orders-pipeline"
  secret_name     = "MARMOT_API_KEY"
  plaintext_value = marmot_service_account_api_key.ci.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key
- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the service account the key belongs to

### Optional

- `expires_in_days` (Number) Days until the key expires. Omit for a key that never expires.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp, if the key expires
- `id` (String) Key ID
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The plaintext API key, captured at creation.
